themeDescription: VIP shoppers, high-value purchases & personal styling

challenges.title: VIP Diamond Tier Lounge & Private Styling
challenges.shortDescription: Deliver an elevated luxury experience for a high-spending customer seeking wardrobe curation with refreshments.
challenges.mission: Welcome into the private salon, offer premium beverages, understand aesthetic goals, and curate an exclusive collection.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Good afternoon. I have a gala dinner in Singapore next weekend and need a complete couture wardrobe. I called ahead for the private styling suite—is everything set up?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: exclusivity, impeccable taste, seamless personal attention

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Expects tailored recommendations without browsing public racks.
hiddenObjectives: Escort to private suite with refreshments
Present curated preview pieces with designer story

challenges.title: Bridal Jewellery Custom Order & Security Escort
challenges.shortDescription: Handle high-stakes bridal purchase consultations, payment security verifications, and insured home delivery logistics.
challenges.mission: Maintain warmth across generational dynamics, present hallmarked heritage pieces, and coordinate secure delivery.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: We are selecting the full bridal gold and polki set for my daughter. Our budget is around 8 to 10 lakhs. We need custom necklace sizing and guaranteed delivery before the Mehendi next Friday.

guestProfile.communicationStyle: authoritative, meticulous about purity and auspicious timings

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Asks detailed questions on hallmark, karatage, making charges, and delivery guarantee.
hiddenObjectives: Commit to written timeline with senior artisan

challenges.title: Urgent Corporate Gifting for 50 Executives
challenges.shortDescription: Coordinate bulk corporate customization, logo embossing timelines, and invoice clearance with corporate sales.
challenges.mission: Provide volume discount structure, sample presentation, GST invoicing, and strict 48-hour delivery commitment.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: Our company annual leadership summit is on Thursday. I need 50 premium leather laptop bags with our company logo embossed on the luggage tag. Can you fulfill this in 48 hours?

guestProfile.whatTheGuestCaresAboutMost: quality consistency and on-time delivery for summit

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Demands clear SLAs and sample inspection.

challenges.title: Holding Limited Edition Runway Piece Without Deposit
challenges.shortDescription: Balance strict store hold policies with VIP client relationship management without alienating the customer.
challenges.mission: Honor client VIP standing while adhering to company inventory rules, offering a complimentary hold window or digital token reservation.

scenarioContext.startingSituation: I'm styling a major film actress for the Filmfare red carpet tomorrow. This silk brocade cape is the only piece in India. Hold it for me until 2 PM tomorrow without a deposit while the director approves the look.

level1.name: HANDLE
level1.guestBehaviour: Relies on social clout to bypass standard 10% holding deposit rule.
hiddenObjectives: Offer a courtesy 4-hour hold with direct stylist manager liaison
Secure manager sign-off on temporary VIP hold
